messages:
ellie: Heads-up: PR #4621 is blocking a migration. CI shows multiple optimize toolkit snippets using deprecated quant keys and old batching params. Customer is waiting on a migration guide.

tom: I can take this. Which pages are failing?

ellie: /optimize/quant-profiles.md, /optimize/examples/python_batching.md, and the migration guide under /optimize/migration-guide.md. Also the embed example has a bad internal link to /docs/legacy/kv-cache.md.

priya: Reproduced locally. The SDK snippets currently use `quant_type: q4_0` and `batch_size: 1`. Runtime now expects named profiles (e.g. `q_standard_q4_1`) and batching should show `batching.window_ms` + `batching.max_inflight`. Also add a small cache example with `kv_ttl_secs`.

priya: Proposed minimal quant profile YAML for the docs:
```yaml
# optimize/quant-profiles.md - example profile for q4_1
quant_profile:
  name: q_standard_q4_1
  type: q4_1
  per_channel: true
  calibrate: false
  notes: "Balanced perf + stability for medium-length sequences"
```

tom: Nice. I'll update the Python SDK example to the new shape. Something like:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='REDACTED')

resp = client.generate(
  model='redwood/fast-13b-q_standard_q4_1',
  input='Explain vector clocks in one paragraph',
  optimize={
    'batching': {'window_ms': 50, 'max_inflight': 8},
    'cache': {'kv_ttl_secs': 600, 'prefix_kv': True},
    'quant_profile': 'q_standard_q4_1'
  }
)
print(resp.text)
```

kevin: I'll run the linkcheck job and add redirects for the legacy page. docs-bot flagged one broken link earlier. Also will add a tiny test that renders the snippet and asserts no markdown parsing errors.

docs-bot: [automated] Linkcheck: 2 broken links (PR 4621). Files: optimize/examples/python_batching.md line 14, optimize/embedding.md line 38.

ellie: Two follow-ups: 1) Add a short migration note describing perf/accuracy tradeoffs moving from q4_0 -> q4_1 and how to fallback to a FP16 model if quantized accuracy degrades. 2) Pin the docs snippet CI to runtime image `redwood/runtime:2026-02` when verifying.

priya: I added a paragraph to migration-guide.md about numeric stability and a sample command to run a quick eval: `scripts/fast_quant_eval.sh --profile q_standard_q4_1 --dataset smoke`. Also included a note that q4_1 reduces memory but may change logits slightly for rare tokens.

kevin: CI fixes in branch `docs/4621-quant-fixes` pushed. Linkcheck and mkdocs build passed locally. Added redirect: /docs/legacy/kv-cache.md -> /optimize/batching-and-cache.md.

tom: Merged after CI passed. I left a short changelog entry: "optimize: update quant profile examples to q_standard_q4_1; show batching.window_ms and cache.kv_ttl_secs in examples".

ellie: Great. Please add an entry to the release notes and notify support with the migration snippet link so they can update any customer playbooks.

kevin: Done. I filed follow-up issue to sweep other pages for `q4_0` mentions: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/121

priya: If customers hit accuracy regressions, tell them to try `model='redwood/fast-13b-fp16'` as fallback and open a support ticket.

ellie: Thanks team 389. Close loop when support confirms the blocked customer is unblocked.
